name: Favored Wielder (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
As a symbolic expression of their religious devotion, some inquisitors train with the favored weapon of their god to an obsessive degree. Achieving an uncanny mastery with this weapon, a favored wielder greets every combat situation with exultant glee. When a favored wielder fights, church is in session.

Blessed Combatant (Sp)

Starting at 2nd level, the favored wielder is under the constant effects of the bless spell whenever she wields her deity’s favored weapon. Instead of once during the spell’s duration, the favored wielder can roll an attack roll or saving throw twice and take the higher result once per day, plus an additional time per day at levels 6, 12, and 18.

This replaces detect alignment.

Martial Spirit (Ex)

At 3rd level, a favored wielder treats her inquisitor levels as fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for combat feats. In addition, she treats her inquisitor levels as her Base Attack Bonus for the purpose of qualifying for combat feats. She gains a bonus combat feat at 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter. Whenever she selects a combat feat that applies to a type of weapon, this feat must apply to her deity’s favored weapon.

This replaces solo tactics and teamwork feats.

Sanctified Armor (Sp)

At 5 level, as a standard action, a favored wielder can affect the armor or clothing she is wearing with the sanctify armor spell for a number of minutes per day equal to her inquisitor level. These need not be consecutive, but must be spent in 1 minute increments.

This replaces discern lies.
